text:
alex_sales: Hi team, POC with Acme Corp is blocked. They see: "model not available in region: eu-west-1" when calling model=gpt-open-3b-v2. Root error: 403/ModelUnavailable.
customer_rep: Confirmed — error happened at 09:12 UTC, getting ModelUnavailable. We're on their sandbox creds.
maria_se: Is the model pinned in their app config? If pinned to 3b-v2 and the variant got deprecated in eu-west today that could explain.
kevin_runtime: Checking deployment catalog... I see gpt-open-3b-v2 deprecated in eu-west-1 - yesterday's rollout. There's gpt-open-3b-v2-compat in us-east-1 only.
julia_support: Can the app fallback to a compatible variant? Also, what's the customer's SLA requirement for latency?
customer_rep: Latency target is <200ms. They preferred eu region for data residency but can tolerate US during POC for short time.
maria_se: Ok. Short term: suggest switching their endpoint to model=gpt-open-3b-compat (in us-east). Also we can enable regional fallback in their routing policy.
kevin_runtime: Actionable steps:
1) Confirm they aren't force-pinning a specific model version.
2) If pinned, we can allowlist an alternative via the control plane: `PATCH /v1/projects/{p}/clients/{c}/config` body `{ "model_fallbacks": ["gpt-open-3b-compat"] }`.
3) For immediate test, ask them to call:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-3b-compat","input":"Summarize..."}'
```
alex_sales: I'm going to propose the US fallback to Acme and note this is temporary until we get EU variant restored.
deploy-bot: [09:20] Model deprecation rollout: gpt-open-3b-v2 removed in eu-west-1 (change-id: rwd-2026-0421-07).
julia_support: Kevin, any ETA on restoring eu-west availability or promoting a quantized build there?
kevin_runtime: Ops is building a quantized 3b-compat for eu; ETA ~48hrs. Alternative is enabling cross-region routing for their POC — will add to task.
customer_rep: Ok to route to us-east for now. Please document any impact on response times.
alex_sales: I'll send the temporary change and update the SOW. Maria, can you handle the security note re: data residency during POC?
maria_se: Yes — will add a line: PII remains in transit to us-east and will be deleted after POC. Also propose synthetic data for sensitive flows.
julia_support: Closing loop — action items: kevin to enable allowlist + monitor, maria to update security note, alex to confirm with customer. Reopen here if anything fails. :thumbsup:
customer_rep: Thanks all, trying the curl now and will report back in 10m.
kevin_runtime: I pushed a temporary routing rule to route Acme's project to us-east-1 for model gpt-open-3b-compat. Watch logs:
```
[2026-04-22T09:25:12Z] project=acme_poc request_id=abcd1234 model=gpt-open-3b-compat region=us-east-1 latency_ms=145
```
customer_rep: Confirmed. Test request succeeded, latency ~160ms. POC can proceed.
alex_sales: Great — I'll update CRM and mark POC as green for now. We'll follow up on EU restore.
